text:
Maya: Heads-up — I'm pushing a change to infra/terraform/network to add NAT routing. Quick Q on CI: when I change only tfvars and a k8s manifest we end up with a GH Actions workflow commenting on the PR which then triggers Atlantis autoplan — looks like a double-plan loop. Anyone seen this or have a lightweight dedupe pattern? @Jun @Priya

Jun: We ran into this before. Two common fixes: 1) make the GH action that comments use paths/paths-ignore to avoid firing on non-infra changes; 2) add a small conditional step that checks changed files and exits early. Paths can be awkward with symlinks though.

Priya: We ended up using `gh pr view $PR --json files` inside the workflow to inspect changed files and set an output like `infra_changed=true`. Then use `if: steps.check.outputs.infra_changed == 'true'` to drive the Atlantis-comment step. It's slightly slower but robust.

Omar: Alternatively, flip autoplan off and require a bot comment for infra directories only. Atlantis supports `autoplan: false` and then you only call `atlantis plan` via comment when repo-level checks pass. Tradeoff: more manual.

Maya: We want autoplan for most infra PRs but avoid it for docs/ci churn — symlink to docs is making paths-ignore noisy. The gh CLI approach seems reasonable.

Li: Another tiny pattern we use: `git fetch origin $BASE && git diff --name-only origin/$BASE...$HEAD | grep -q '^infra/' && echo "changed" || echo "noop"` in a step and set an output. No GH API rate hits.

Priya: Good call. Also FYI add a tiny cache for gh auth token in the workflow to avoid hitting GH limits if you scan many PRs.

Maya: Separate but related — ArgoCD sync is flapping on one service: apply from Atlantis creates a k8s Secret then ArgoCD tries to sync the app that references it and fails intermittently (secret not present at render time). Any ordering tricks?

Sasha: We solved that using ArgoCD sync-wave annotations. Create a dedicated "secret-bootstrap" Application (or a kustomize overlay) with `argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave: "0"` for secrets and mark apps that depend on those secrets with `sync-wave: "10"`. That ensures secrets are applied first.

Jun: If you're using sealed-secrets, commit sealed secrets to git so ArgoCD has them available at diff time and the controller will unseal. If you're using external secret controllers (AWS/Hashi), ensure the provider controller has the RBAC and runs in a lower sync-wave too.

deploy-bot: Workflow run: infra-ci (GH Actions) #872 started by @Maya — changed files: infra/terraform/network/main.tf, infra/terraform/vars.tf — status: queued

Maya: Thanks all. Plan: add a pre-check step (git diff or gh pr files) and gate the Atlantis-comment step, plus add an ArgoCD sync-wave for the secret bootstrap. I'll push a draft PR and @Priya / @Jun can review the GH action snippet. :thumbsup:

Priya: Happy to review — ping when ready.

Li: If you want I can paste our mini `changed-files` action snippet into the PR to speed things up.

Maya: Will do, thanks everyone!
